messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: Canary 'predictive-api-canary' alerting -> multiple failures detected (6 failures in 5m). Paging oncall now. See monitor: https://monitors.internal/redwood/predictive-api-canary :rotating_light:
Alex Chen: Oncall Alex - got the page. Looking at monitor graph now, spikes of 504 and a cluster of latency > 1s around 13:42 UTC.
Samir Patel: I can see the same. Traces show backend model_pool returning 504s intermittently. No deploys in last hour.
Leah Wong: Any customer-facing errors reported? Support says a handful of low-volume 5xx errors from EU region but nothing widespread yet.
Alex Chen: Good. Initial mitigation: I'm going to put the canary into notify-only for 10m to stop the pager storm while we investigate, and then tighten the conditions so single transient probes don't page.
Maria Gonzalez: +1 for notify-only. Also we should record this as a noisy canary incident and create a followup to tune thresholds.
ops-bot: ACTION: canary predict-API set alert_mode=notify-only for 10m by Alex Chen (command: `monctl mute --monitor predictive-api-canary --duration 10m`)
Alex Chen: Ran the mute. Paging suppressed.
Samir Patel: Looking at recent logs from model_pool-3, there's a thread exhaustion warning right before the first failures: 
```
WARN thread_pool: worker queue depth 1024 (limit 1024)
ERROR upstream: timeout while waiting for worker (duration 1200ms)
```
Could be a transient GC pause or a short overload.
Leah Wong: If this is transient, we should avoid paging on single sample failures. Proposal: change canary alerting to require 3 consecutive HTTP failures within a 10m rolling window before paging, keep latency SLO at 500ms for dashboarding but don't page on latency alone. Also increase probe interval to 120s to reduce noise from short spikes. Thoughts?
Samir Patel: I like requiring consecutive failures. I'd prefer 3/5 over 10m (3 failures in 5 probes) so we still detect real outages quickly. If interval becomes 120s then 3/5 is too slow (10 minutes). Maybe set interval 60s + consecutive_failures=3; or interval 120s + consecutive_failures=2.
Alex Chen: Good point. For quick detection with noise reduction: keep interval 60s, require 3 consecutive failures before paging. That yields a ~3min detection with noise suppression.
Maria Gonzalez: Works for me. Also create a read-only dashboard panel for synthetic-only errors so we can correlate with real user errors: add panels for canary error rate, canary latency p95, model_pool queue depth, and relevant pod restarts. Tag dashboard as INFR/Canary-Tuning.
ops-bot: CONFIG-CHANGE: updating monitor predictive-api-canary
```
interval: 60s
consecutive_failures_to_page: 3
alert_mode: notify-only (currently muted, will return to page mode after validation)
thresholds:
  status_codes: [200]
  max_latency_ms: 500
```
Change applied by Alex Chen.
Alex Chen: Unmuting alert once changes are verified. I'll watch the next 15 minutes and then flip back to page-mode if no further transient failures.
Samir Patel: I've put a quick patch on model_pool to add backpressure logging and a limit guard; PR: https://git.internal/redwood/model_pool/pulls/289 (non-breaking, logs only). Recommend we roll that next maintenance window.
Leah Wong: Created follow-up ticket INFR-1234: "Canary tuning + dashboard for predictive-api-canary" with proposed edits (interval, consecutive failures, dashboard panels, replay tests). Assigned to Samir for root-cause and Alex for monitoring changes.
Maria Gonzalez: For the on-call handoff: I need to step out at 02:00 UTC. Alex can continue watch; I'll take morning follow-up at 10:00 UTC and own the post-incident review.
Alex Chen: I'll monitor. If anything else pops, page me. Also suggest we add a runbook snippet to avoid immediate paging during transient 5xx bursts: recommend adding a "suppress-if-user-errors<1%" gate so canary pages only if real-user error rate is also elevated.
Samir Patel: Agree — adding a correlated signal reduces false positives a lot. I'll propose a metric-based gate in the follow-up ticket.
Maria Gonzalez: Thanks everyone. After 15m observation with the new config I'll flip to page-mode and post final status.
ops-bot: NOTE: Monitor unmute scheduled at 1778216332 by Alex Chen if no regressions observed.
Alex Chen: 15m observation done, no further sustained failures. Switching monitor back to page-mode with consecutive_failures=3.
ops-bot: CONFIG-CHANGE: monitor predictive-api-canary set alert_mode=page by Alex Chen
Alex Chen: Handoff summary for morning:
- Root cause: transient thread_pool pressure on model_pool -> intermittent 504s
- Immediate mitigation: mute->adjusted alerting to require 3 consecutive failures + kept interval 60s
- Next actions: INFR-1234 (canary tuning + dashboard), PR 289 for extra logging/backpressure, consider model_pool worker tuning in next sprint
- Handoff: Maria will lead the postmortem and dashboard work tomorrow.
Maria Gonzalez: I'll take it. Thanks Alex :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: Thanks team.
incident-bot: INCIDENT: predictive-api-canary resolved (no failures in last 15m).
Alex Chen: Closing thread, will add notes to the incident board and link INFR-1234.
Maria Gonzalez: I'll draft the post-incident follow-up and share next steps.
